This wheat plot is small but wheat needs fertilizer to give a good harvest, so I will buy some DAP and urea from the cooperative, even though the plot is rented and money is tight. I have no schooling and I trust the local seed I have used before — improved seed costs more and I cannot risk it on rented land. I will use my own family labor and the manure from our animals; I do not have money for pesticide or for hiring workers on such a small plot.
